from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document extracted from the input."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document, e.g., 'inheritance dispute', 'administrative litigation'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extracted information from the parsed documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
